blocks.text: Explanation:- When authority comes to someone, it seems good, just as the suckling woman seems good to the child. When authority slips out of his hands, it becomes hateful, just as the one who weans becomes hateful to the child; this is the meaning of the last words of this hadith.

blocks.arabic_text: عَنْ عَوْفِ بْنِ مَالِكٍ ﵁ أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللهِ ﷺ قَالَ: إِنْ شِئْتُمْ أَنْبَأْتُكُمْ عَنِ اْلإِمَارَةِ، وَمَا هِيَ؟ فَنَادَيْتُ بِأَعْلَي صَوْتِي ثَلَاثَ مَرَّاتٍ: وَمَا هِيَ يَارَسُولَ اللهِ؟ قَالَ: أَوَّلُهَا مَلَامَةٌ، وَثانِيهَا نَدَامَةٌ، وَثَالِثُهَا عَذَابٌ يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ إِلَّا مَنْ عَدَلَ، وَكَيْفَ يَعْدِلُ مَعَ قَرَابَتِهِ؟
blocks.source_reference_arabic: رواه البزار والطبراني في الكبير والاوسط باختصار ورجال الكبير رجال الصحيح، مجمع الزوائد:٥ /٣٦٣
blocks.tamil_translation: Hazrat Awf ibn Malik (RA) narrates, the Prophet ﷺ said, “If you wish, I will tell you about the inner reality of this leadership.” “O Rasulullah, what is its inner reality?” I asked three times in a loud voice. The Prophet ﷺ said, “Its first stage is blame, its second stage is regret, its third stage is punishment on the Day of Qiyamah, except for the one who acted justly! Whoever acted justly will be protected from the punishment. (However,) how can a person be just and fair in the affairs of those close to him, such as relatives? Even if he wants justice and fairness, love of relatives will not let him act with justice and fairness. And he will find himself having to lean towards his relatives.
